title: Alvin Kamara: I couldn't be happier that Saints signed Travis Etienne

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Alvin Kamara: I couldn't be happier that Saints signed Travis Etienne
sources.description: Alvin Kamara didn't specifically address his plans for next season during an interview on Terron Armstead's podcast The Set, but the running back sounds like he wants to play for the Saints this season.
